title: Output Correction Command
description: Authenticated user authorization to correct a specified role output without repeating completed scientific work. The command identifies the exact run, role closure, validation attempt, expected lifecycle head, correction type, permitted output scope, and optional user instruction.

expected_lifecycle_head.description: The lifecycle head sequence the researcher expects, for optimistic concurrency.

correction_type.description: revalidate: re-check unchanged bytes. normalize: apply allowlisted mechanical transformations. packaging: fix envelope structure without scientific change. scientific: fix a scientific claim within frozen scope.

permitted_output_scope.description: Output contract IDs that the correction may touch.

user_instruction.description: Optional researcher-authored instruction for scientific correction. Null for revalidate, normalize, and packaging.

transformation_codes.description: For normalize only: the allowlisted transformation codes to apply.
